candidates.title: Separate formatting, invalid-action and task-limit failures
candidates.rule: When evaluating an interactive agent, record format errors, illegal actions, context exhaustion and task-limit exhaustion separately before choosing harness changes.
candidates.passage: In Database and Digital Card Game tasks, Invalid Format errors frequently occur due to stringent formatting requirements
candidates.finding: Failure proportions differ sharply by environment: database format failures average 53.3%, while household invalid actions average 64.1%. Using these categories to prioritize repairs is an inference; the paper does not ablate the proposed diagnostic workflow.
models: 29 historical API and open models; GPT-4, GPT-3.5, Claude and Llama-2 families
candidates.conditions: Outcomes are environment-specific and aggregated across models; drill down to the deployed model rather than treating averages as its diagnosis.
candidates.limitations: A task-limit timeout does not uniquely identify poor reasoning; budgets, tools and environment errors can also contribute. No causal repair intervention is established.
candidates.validation_test: Instrument outcomes on representative tasks; target the dominant category and compare the resulting harness against baseline on a disjoint task set.
